learningObjectives: Identify common regular expression patterns and metacharacters.
Use Python's re module to search, match, and replace text.
Build patterns for validating and extracting structured information.

activities.title: Regex Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a regular expression.

content.concept: Regular expressions describe text patterns using characters, groups, quantifiers, and anchors.

activities.title: Pattern Match

content.concept: Regex patterns can identify specific structures such as numbers, words, emails, and repeated characters.

activities.title: Regex Builder
activities.instruction: Build a pattern for the target text.

content.concept: Regex patterns can be composed from character classes, quantifiers, groups, and anchors.

activities.title: Pattern Tester
activities.instruction: Adjust the pattern and inspect matching text.

content.concept: Testing a regular expression against sample text helps verify whether the pattern captures the intended data.
